gloss.zh-Hans: 位置、点或状态 → 在场／存在

meaning.zh-Hans: 通过 LOCATION → PRESENCE 建立的候选比较；并非所有语境都可互换。

rationale.en: The strongest support is the semantic intersection LOCATION → PRESENCE; /æ/ ↔ /aɪ̯/ is only a limited vowel observation.
rationale.zh-Hans: 最强支持是 LOCATION → PRESENCE 的语义交点；/æ/ ↔ /aɪ̯/ 仅为有限元音观察。

summary.en: English at, Chinese 在 and Chinese 爱 have independent histories. No common origin is claimed.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 at、汉语“在”和“爱”各有独立历史；不主张共同来源。

summary.en: at /æt/ ↔ 在 zài /tsaɪ̯/ is a candidate vowel and phonetic-semantic observation; /t/ does not correspond regularly to /ts/, and Mandarin tone is unmatched.
summary.zh-Hans: at /æt/ ↔ 在 zài /tsaɪ̯/ 是候选元音与语音—语义观察；/t/ 与 /ts/ 不构成规律对应，普通话声调也无对应。

summary.en: LOCATION → PRESENCE → RELATION → WORLD

summary.en: The comparison is testable but currently untested.

claim.en: at /æt/ ↔ 在 zài /tsaɪ̯/: limited open/front vowel resemblance plus semantic intersection.
claim.zh-Hans: at /æt/ ↔ 在 zài /tsaɪ̯/：有限的开放／前部元音听感近似与语义交点。

limitations.en: English /t/ and Mandarin /ts/ occupy different positions; no regular sound correspondence is established.
limitations.zh-Hans: 英语 /t/ 与普通话 /ts/ 位置不同；未建立规律音变。

claim.en: The modern forms at and 在 may support a limited phonetic-semantic association around location and presence.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代词形 at 与“在”可能围绕位置与在场形成有限语音—语义联想。

testability.zh-Hans: 可用盲法听辨、语料语义重叠与明确负对照检验。

entries.author: Jinkai Liu

editorial_notes.en: Publication, mapping, evidence/historical relation and literature are independent axes.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 词条发表、mapping、证据／历史关系与文学层是四条独立状态轴。

gloss.en: A monastery or convent governed by an abbot or abbess; also its buildings or church
gloss.zh-Hans: 由男修道院院长或女修道院院长主持的修道院，也可指其建筑或教堂

meaning.en: The primary Chinese lexical equivalent is 修道院. 比, 笔 and 蓓 are not standard translations.
meaning.zh-Hans: 主要汉语词义对应是“修道院”；“比”“笔”“蓓”都不是标准翻译。

rationale.en: Authoritative English and French dictionaries define the word as a monastic institution. The Chinese target records that ordinary lexical meaning; sound and literary candidates remain separate observations.
rationale.zh-Hans: 权威英语、法语词典均把该词定义为修道制度中的机构。汉语目标记录普通词义对应；声音候选与文学候选另轨保存。

summary.en: English abbey came through Middle English and Anglo-French from Medieval Latin abbātia. The base title abbās/abbot ultimately reflects Aramaic abba ‘father’ through ecclesiastical Greek and Christian Latin. This supports an indirect historical connection to Abba, not a direct borrowing from a modern Jewish form and not a relation to Chinese bi/bei.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey 经中古英语和盎格鲁-法语进入，来源是中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。其基础称谓 abbās／abbot 又经教会希腊语和基督教拉丁语上溯至阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。这说明它与 Abba 有间接的深层词史联系，并非直接借自某个现代犹太教形式，也不证明与汉语 bi／bei 有历史关系。

claim.en: Middle English abbeye/abbay was borrowed from Anglo-French abeie/abbaye, from Medieval Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abbeye／abbay 借自盎格鲁-法语 abeie／abbaye，后者来自中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。

claim.en: French abbé comes from Christian Latin abbās, transmitted through ecclesiastical Greek from Aramaic abba ‘father’; abbaye is derived from that abbatial title through Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbé 来自基督教拉丁语 abbās；该称谓经教会希腊语源自阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。abbaye 则经拉丁语 abbātia 从这一院长称谓派生。

claim.en: French abbesse is borrowed from Christian Latin abbatissa, a derivative of abbas, and names the female head of an abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbesse 借自基督教拉丁语 abbatissa，是 abbas 的派生词，指女修道院院长。

summary.en: Modern abbey /ˈæbi/ has a surface-final resemblance to Mandarin bǐ /pi/; French abbaye /a.be.i/ and abbé /a.be/ can also sound loosely similar to bi/bei. These are non-systematic modern-form resemblances. 比 and 笔 lack the required lexical meaning; 蓓 gains relevance only through a literary metaphor.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 的词尾与普通话 bǐ /pi/ 有表面近似；法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/ 与 bi／bei 也可能产生宽泛听感近似。这些都不是系统音变。“比”“笔”缺少所需词义，“蓓”只通过文学隐喻获得关联。

claim.en: abbey-final /bi/ and 比/笔 bǐ /pi/ share a high front vowel and a labial stop, but differ in voicing/phonological system, syllable position and Mandarin tone.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 词尾 /bi/ 与“比／笔”bǐ /pi/ 共享高前元音与唇塞音，但在浊音／音系、音节位置及普通话声调上不同。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/ and 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯/ offer a loose auditory resemblance, but no regular historical correspondence or independent lexical-semantic match has been shown.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/ 与“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯/ 有宽泛听感近似，但尚无规律历史对应或独立词义对应。

summary.en: The standard concept is a monastic institution/community. Spiritual cultivation as growth is a plausible interpretive frame, but the bud-to-rose transformation belongs to the literary layer.
summary.zh-Hans: 标准概念是修道机构／共同体。“灵魂修持如成长”可作解释性框架，但“蓓蕾长成玫瑰”的转换属于文学层。

summary.en: The 比, 笔 and 蓓 comparisons are retained as separately graded author observations. None is historical evidence or a replacement for 修道院.
summary.zh-Hans: “比”“笔”“蓓”的比较作为分别分级的作者观察保留；均不是历史证据，也不替代“修道院”。

claim.en: 比 bǐ is a phonetic candidate only; no supporting abbey-related lexical meaning is recorded.
claim.zh-Hans: “比”bǐ 仅为声音候选；未记录与修道院相关的支持性词义。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ is a weak/speculative observation. The proposed ‘using a pen’ interpretation lacks an independently established semantic bridge to abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 是弱／推测性观察。“用笔”的解释缺少独立成立的语义桥梁。

claim.en: 蓓 bèi / 蓓蕾 is a literary phonetic-semantic association: an abbey imagined as a place where the soul develops like a rosebud.
claim.zh-Hans: “蓓”bèi／“蓓蕾”是文学性的声音—语义联想：把修道院想象为灵魂如玫瑰蓓蕾般成长之所。

claim.en: English abbey /ˈæbi/ ends in /bi/, while Mandarin 比 and 笔 are bǐ /pi˨˩˦/.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 以 /bi/ 结尾；普通话“比”“笔”为 bǐ /pi˨˩˦/。

limitations.en: This is a surface resemblance, not a demonstrated sound law. English /b/ and Mandarin pinyin b represent different phonetic categories, and Mandarin tone has no counterpart here.
limitations.zh-Hans: 这是表面音似，不是已证明的音变规律。英语 /b/ 与普通话拼音 b 所代表的语音范畴不同，普通话声调在此也无对应。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/, abbé /a.be/ and abbesse /a.bɛs/ share the historical abb-/ab- family; 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ only resembles part of these modern sounds.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/、abbesse /a.bɛs/ 属于有词史关系的 abb-／ab- 词族；“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ 只与部分现代音形近似。

limitations.en: The relation among the French forms is historical; their resemblance to Chinese bei is not. Surface similarity must not be transferred across those two claims.
limitations.zh-Hans: 法语各形式之间有历史关系；它们与汉语 bei 的近似没有已证历史关系。不能把前一事实转移成后一结论。

semantic_structure.relation: RELIGIOUS INSTITUTION → MONASTIC COMMUNITY; literary extension: SPIRITUAL CULTIVATION → GROWTH

claim.en: The final syllable of abbey may invite a phonetic association with 比 bǐ, without a semantic or historical claim.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 的末音节可能引发与“比”bǐ 的声音联想，但不提出语义或历史关系主张。

counterexamples: No abbey-related lexical meaning in 比
English voicing vs Mandarin aspiration contrast

testability.en: Use blinded similarity ratings with unrelated /bi, pi, bei/ controls; semantic support must be tested separately.
testability.zh-Hans: 可用盲法相似度评分，并加入无关 /bi、pi、bei/ 负对照；语义支持必须另行检验。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ may be heard as similar to abbey-final /bi/, but ‘using a pen’ does not currently supply a supported abbey meaning.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 在听感上可能接近 abbey 词尾 /bi/，但“用笔”目前不能提供有支持的修道院词义。

counterexamples: Many unrelated words can share /bi/-like syllables

testability.en: Require a preregistered semantic criterion and negative controls before promotion; otherwise retain as a weak observation.
testability.zh-Hans: 升级前须预先注册语义判据并设置负对照；否则只保留为弱观察。

claim.en: Abbaye/abbey and 蓓 bèi can support a literary image of an abbey as a place where the soul grows like a bud, without etymological force.
claim.zh-Hans: abbaye／abbey 与“蓓”bèi 可支持“修道院如灵魂蓓蕾成长之所”的文学意象，但不具有词源证明力。

counterexamples: 蓓蕾 is not the standard translation of abbey
Metaphorical meaning supplied by the author

testability.en: Evaluate as literary reception or mnemonic association, not as an etymological hypothesis.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为文学接受或记忆联想评价，而不是词源假说。

proposition.en: An abbey is a place where the soul is cultivated like a bud opening toward a rose.
proposition.zh-Hans: 修道院如灵魂的蓓蕾之所，在修持中向玫瑰生长。

evidence_boundary.en: The bud, rose and spiritual-growth image is authored literature. It is searchable and preserved, but it is not lexical translation, historical etymology or independent semantic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 蓓蕾、玫瑰与灵魂成长的意象属于作者文学创作。它可检索、被保留，但不是词义翻译、历史词源或独立语义证据。

source.raw_note: 英语：abbey ['æbi] n. 修道院。法语：abbaye n. 修道院；abbé n. 修道院院长；abbesse n. 女修道院院长。汉语候选：比 bi；笔 bi；以及文学候选‘蓓 bei／蓓蕾’。解释：这个词应该从犹太教的阿比而来。而比或许是用笔 bi 的意思。或者解释成蓓 bei、蓓蕾；这里用一个蓓蕾的蓓字对应，因为修道院是人的灵魂的修持，而生长出绚丽的玫瑰的蓓蕾的圣所。
